items.title: File objection (Einspruch) against the fine notice
items.quote: Dieser Bußgeldbescheid wird rechtskräftig und vollstreckbar, wenn Sie nicht innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der oben bezeichneten Verwaltungsbehörde Einspruch einlegen.
items.computation: This is a Bußgeldbescheid served by formal delivery (Förmliche Zustellung / Zustellungsurkunde per § 182 ZPO). The envelope scan on page 2 shows 'zugestellt am 17.09.2026' – this printed date is the delivery day itself, no days are added (formal delivery rule). 17.09.2026 is a Thursday. Per § 67 OWiG / § 43 StPO, the objection period is two weeks from delivery, counted under §§ 187, 188 BGB: the day of delivery (17.09.) is not counted, the period starts 18.09.2026 and runs two weeks to the same weekday two weeks later, i.e. Thursday 01.10.2026. This day is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Bayern, so no shift under § 43 Abs. 2 StPO is needed. Deadline: 01.10.2026.

items.title: Pay total fine amount (Geldbuße, fee and costs)
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das unten genannte Konto.
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks after the notice becomes final (Rechtskraft), which – assuming no Einspruch is filed – occurs at the end (midnight) of the objection period computed above, i.e. Rechtskraft begins 02.10.2026 (Friday). Counting two weeks from that day under §§ 187, 188 BGB (day of Rechtskraft not counted, period ends on the same weekday two weeks later): 02.10.2026 + 2 weeks = Friday 16.10.2026. This is not a Saturday, Sunday or Bavarian public holiday, so no shift under § 193 BGB is required. This deadline only applies if no timely Einspruch is lodged; an Einspruch would suspend enforceability of the fine.

warnings: The payment deadline of 16.10.2026 only applies if the person does not file a timely Einspruch by 01.10.2026; filing an objection suspends the obligation to pay and the case proceeds instead.
